passages.cue: Tap the composite rhythm on a table first, then play it hands together very slowly.

passages.label: Octave passage
passages.description: Bars 25–28: octaves in the right hand and leaps in the left hand, peaking around 24 notes a second.
passages.cue: Practise the octaves blocked and slow with a loose wrist, then group them in fours at tempo.

passages.cue: Take the upper and lower lines separately first, then join them in dotted rhythms.
